# friend-link-kit

> Pure Rust encoding and decoding for decentralised game invites and their encrypted hello packets.

## Documentation

- [Invite wire and integration](https://github.com/forgesworn/friend-link-kit/blob/main/README.md): Cargo package name, packet formats and caller responsibilities.

## ForgeSworn ecosystem

- [ForgeSworn library guide](https://forgesworn.dev/llms.txt): Find related libraries, tools and integration guides by task and runtime.
- [ForgeSworn on GitHub](https://github.com/forgesworn): Browse the organisation’s public repositories.
- [Project source](https://github.com/forgesworn/friend-link-kit): Canonical source repository, documentation and release information.
